title: Tears Music mod
description: the mod to replace the theme sound with the record of the tears music disc from a future version
body:
🎶 No Tears Music

Tired of the noisy, ambient intro in Minecraft’s Tears music disc?
This lightweight client-side Fabric mod replaces the Tears disc with a clean version of the main track only.

✨ Features:

🎵 Plays the Tears music disc without the noisy intro/ambient layers

🖥️ Client-side only – safe to use on any multiplayer server

🔊 Compatible with Minecraft’s in-game music volume controls

⚡ Lightweight, no configs, just drop it in your mods folder

📦 Supported Versions:

Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric Loader)
